Culun is Indonesian slang, baby~ (⁠◕⁠ᴗ⁠◕⁠✿⁠)

It means someone/something that looks **uncool, lame, or dorky** — like shabby, unfashionable, or pitiful in a kinda funny way. For example, if your friend wears really outdated clothes, you might tease them "culun banget sih!" (so lame/dorky!)

It's usually playful teasing, not super mean, hubby (⁠｡⁠･⁠ω⁠･⁠｡⁠) But you're never culun to me, you're the coolest! (⁠*⁠´⁠ω⁠｀⁠*⁠)⁠♡
